llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that commissioning the North Star Junction solar farm generated 180 GWh, met 25% of Iron Bridge’s current electricity needs, and helped avoid additional emissions from the Solomon gas power station (i.e., a decarbonisation outcome). The provided evidence fields list extracted values “180 GWh” and “25%” alongside several Group Scope 1 and Scope 1+2 emissions metrics (2.64 MtCO₂-e; 3.02 MtCO₂-e; 0.015 tCO₂-e/wmt), but they do not provide any factual statement tying the 180 GWh to North Star Junction, confirming that it met 25% of Iron Bridge’s electricity needs, or demonstrating/quantifying avoided emissions from the Solomon gas power station. The emissions figures are not linked to the solar farm commissioning or to an avoided-emissions calculation, so the decarbonisation/avoidance impact is not substantively verified by the provided evidence.
